description: Search the shop's herbal remedies and natural cosmetics. Matches English and Hebrew product names and descriptions; an empty query lists everything. Prices are integer agorot (ILS minor units).

language.description: Preferred language for titles and descriptions: "en" or "he" (Hebrew). Default en.
